Extreme temporal fluctuations in probability estimates are filtered (see Appendix H). Similar results hold for arXiv (Appendix H).
FIG. 2. Inferred parameters ω1, ω2, and λ for the Internet over time.

FIG. 3. Next-step connection probabilities in the Internet as a function of effective distance and realized past link activity Φ > 0. Blue markers indicate empirical measurements, while red markers show model predictions. At large distances, connection probabilities increase approximately in proportion to Φ, whereas at small distances geometric proximity alone yields high connection probabilities. Bins at large distances with low temporal support are excluded (see Appendix H).
